decisions.statement: Every reply is read into a named shape rather than passed on as Monarch sent that reply.
A reply with a GraphQL error is refused with that error's words whatever the status read.
A request that has not answered in thirty seconds is abandoned rather than waited on.
A status Monarch owns the fault for is asked again, twice, each wait longer.
The thirty seconds cover every try rather than each try on its own.
A status the caller owns the fault for is refused rather than asked again.
Transactions are drawn a page of five hundred at a time until a page comes back short.
An update stamp is asked for on its own.
A minute where nothing moved costs one call.
The credential is handed in rather than read here.
The credential is one module's business.
Nothing here reads or writes a file.

definition: Monarch's own GraphQL API, read into the shapes this harness names
